const int inf = 1 << 30;
const ll linf = 1LL << 60;

struct edge{int to, cap, cost, rev; };

struct MinCostFlow {
    #define MAX_VERTICES 5010
    int V;
    vector<edge> G[MAX_VERTICES];
    int h[MAX_VERTICES];
    int dist[MAX_VERTICES];
    int prevv[MAX_VERTICES], preve[MAX_VERTICES];

    void initialize(int n) {
        V = n;
    }

    void addEdge(int from, int to, int cap, int cost){
        G[from].push_back((edge){to, cap, cost, (int)G[to].size()});
        G[to].push_back((edge){from, 0, -cost, (int)G[from].size()-1});
    }

    int computeMinCostFlow(int s, int t, int flow){
        int totalCost = 0;
        fill(h, h+V, 0);
        while(flow > 0){    
            priority_queue<pi, vector<pi>, greater<pi> > pq;
            fill(dist, dist+V, inf);
            dist[s] = 0;
            pq.push(pi(0,s));
            while(!pq.empty()){
                pi p = pq.top(); pq.pop();
                int v = p.second;

                return -1;
            }
            for(int v = 0; v < V; v++) h[v] += dist[v];

            }
            flow -= d;
            totalCost += d * h[t];
            for(int v = t; v != s; v = prevv[v]){
                edge &e = G[prevv[v]][preve[v]];
                e.cap -= d;
                G[v][e.rev].cap += d;
            }
        }
        return totalCost;
    }
};

MinCostFlow minCostFlowSolver;

int n, m, k, c, d;
int a[50];
int countArr[50];
